name: luismc-specs
description: Specification authoring and validation. `spec-new` interviews the user and writes a normative spec to specs/ with IDed, testable requirements before any implementation begins; `spec-check` validates any spec's numbering and cross-references — duplicate or out-of-order headings and requirement IDs, orphan subsections, gaps, and dangling §/R references including citations into other registered documents. One writes to a numbering discipline, the other proves it held.
